# DRSM: all AI assistant guides in one file

Built by docs/ai/make_llms.sh from AGENTS.md and docs/ai/*.md.

----------------------------------------------------------------
File: AGENTS.md
----------------------------------------------------------------

# AGENTS.md: DRSM for AI coding assistants

DRSM (DataReel System Monitor) monitors Linux and Windows hosts and
shows them on a PHP dashboard. The checks are BASH plugins, run by
`bin/drsm_run.sh` from cron on one monitor host: on the host itself,
on Linux hosts over SSH, or from Windows agent report files. Each run
writes plain text report files; the PHP pages only read those files.
There is no database and no daemon.

This file is for GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude and other assistants,
and for the admins who use them. `.github/copilot-instructions.md`,
`GEMINI.md` and `CLAUDE.md` point here. The task guides are in
`docs/ai/`; `llms.txt` lists them and `llms-full.txt` has all of them
in one file.

## Two kinds of work

1. **Running DRSM for a site** (most admins): host files, plugin
   settings, sites and links, the dashboard settings, cron. Change the
   files under `$DRSMHOME/etc` and `$CONFIGdir`, never the installed
   code. See `docs/ai/maintain-a-site.md`.
2. **Changing DRSM itself**: plugins, the runner, the PHP pages. Work in
   the source tree, run the tests, then reinstall. See
   `docs/ai/write-a-plugin.md` and `docs/ai/change-the-dashboard.md`.

## Where things are

```
bin/drsm_run.sh          plugin runner, writes every report (cron runs it)
bin/archive.sh, purge.sh daily archive and hourly purge of report files
bin/system_*.sh          older per-host scripts, kept for old setups
lib/drsm_plugin.sh       helpers every plugin sources (drsm_warn, drsm_crit, ...)
lib/drsm_conf.sh         KEY=value reader for manifests, host and site files
lib/drsm_sites.sh        organizations, sites, tiers, site.json and links
lib/drsm_history.sh      metrics history for the trends page
lib/drsm_ansible.sh      Ansible INI inventory as the host list (ANSIBLE_INVENTORY)
collectors/              local.sh, ssh-linux.sh, wra.sh (Windows agent reports)
plugins/<cat>/<name>/    plugin.conf + check.sh (on the host) or probe.sh (from the monitor)
plugins/local/           site plugins, never overwritten by updates
etc/drsm.sh              config template, copied to ~/.drsm.sh (or named by DRSM_CONFIG)
etc/hosts/               _defaults.conf + one <host>.conf per host
etc/sites/               <org>.org and <org>/<site>.site files
www/php/                 dashboard pages; drsm_lib.php is the shared code
www/css/drsm.css, www/js/drsm.js   one stylesheet and one script, no framework
utils/install.sh         installs code to $DRSMHOME and pages to $WWWdir
utils/                   migrate_systems_dat.sh, wra_hosts.sh, new_plugin.sh, drsm_web_sync.sh, ...
tests/*.sh               all tests, plain BASH; run every one before a change is done
docs/*.html              user documentation (hand written HTML)
docs/ai/                 these guides; docs/ai/make_llms.sh rebuilds llms-full.txt
PLUGINS.md               full plugin, host file, site and Windows reference
CHANGELOG.md             add every change under "Unreleased"
```

Installed layout: code in `$DRSMHOME` (default `~/drsm`), dashboard in
`$WWWdir` with its PHP settings in `$CONFIGdir/drsm.php`, reports in
`$REPORTdir` (`system_health_report*.txt`, `system_check*_report*.txt`,
`systems/<host>/<host>_report.txt`, `archive/`). Every script reads
`$DRSM_CONFIG` if set, else `~/.drsm.sh`, else `$BASEdir/etc/drsm.sh`.

## Report format (the contract between plugins and pages)

- A plugin prints `INFO - text`, `WARNING - text`, `ERROR - text`,
  `UNKNOWN - text`, `METRIC name{labels}=value` and
  `DETAIL name=value` lines, plus any free text, and exits 0 OK,
  1 WARNING, 2 ERROR, 3 UNKNOWN.
- The runner wraps each plugin in `=== <cat>/<name> [STATE] <secs>s ===`
  and adds `HOSTNAME:`, `ETIME:`, `GROUP:` and other header lines.
- The pages find problems by the `ERROR - ` and `WARNING - ` prefixes
  (note the spaces). Keep message text in that form: `<host> <what> is
  <value>`, for example `web1:/var is at 91% capacity.`

## Rules

- BASH: `#!/bin/bash`, the file header block of the other scripts, tabs
  in nested blocks like the existing code, `function name()` style,
  quote every expansion, `[ ]` tests as in the existing scripts. No
  Python, Perl or other languages in plugins or core scripts.
- Scripts that copy, delete, rename or mirror anything default to a
  dry run and need `--apply`. Keep that for new utils.
- PHP must stay 7.2 compatible (see the note at the top of
  `www/php/drsm_lib.php`): no arrow functions, `??=`, `str_contains()`,
  `match`, or trailing commas in calls. Escape all output with `h()`;
  build page links with `drsm_url()`; start and end pages with
  `drsm_page_start()` and `drsm_page_end()`.
- Pages read files only. Never let a request name a path to read: map
  an ID to a configured file, as `extreports.php` and `readreport.php`
  do.
- Any PHP warning or notice fails `tests/www_test.sh`. Run pages with
  `php -d error_reporting=-1`.
- New PHP files must be added to the `files=` list in
  `utils/install.sh`, or they are not installed.
- Settings for one site never go in the code: host files, site files,
  `_defaults.conf`, `config/drsm.php` (`$SITEtitle`, `$SITElogo`,
  `$NAVextra`, `$EXTreports`, `$STALEminutes`, `$AUTH...`) and
  `site/custom.css`.
- Update `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased), the HTML docs page that covers
  the area, and `PLUGINS.md` for plugin or host file changes. After
  editing anything in `docs/ai/` or this file run
  `docs/ai/make_llms.sh`.

## Testing

```
$ for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" || break; done
```

`drsm_run_test.sh` runs the runner and plugins against a temp tree,
`www_test.sh` renders every page with the PHP command line,
`auth_test.sh` covers the login, `docs_test.sh` checks the HTML docs
links and that `llms-full.txt` is current. To try a change on a real
install without alerts: `drsm_run.sh -n -H <host> -v`.

## Releases

`version.txt` and `CHANGELOG.md` (`## <ver> - <date>`), annotated git
tag `<ver>` (`<ver>-betaN` for betas), source tarball from
`git archive --prefix=dr_system_monitor-<ver>/`.

----------------------------------------------------------------
File: docs/ai/maintain-a-site.md
----------------------------------------------------------------

# Maintain a DRSM site

For admins (and their AI assistants) who run DRSM for an organization.
Change configuration files, not the installed code. Everything below
is plain text; check a change with `drsm_run.sh -l` and test with
`drsm_run.sh -n -H <host> -v` (`-n` sends no alerts).

## Find the install

```
$ echo "${DRSM_CONFIG:-$HOME/.drsm.sh}"     # the config every script reads
$ grep -E 'DRSMHOME|WWWdir|REPORTdir|CONFIGdir' "${DRSM_CONFIG:-$HOME/.drsm.sh}"
$ crontab -l | grep drsm                     # what runs and as whom
```

When a site runs two DRSM installs in one account (a new release
beside an older one), each new-DRSM cron line sets `DRSM_CONFIG`. Use
the same prefix when you run a script by hand.

## Hosts

- One file per host: `$DRSMHOME/etc/hosts/<host>.conf` with `HOST`,
  `DESCRIPTION`, `IMPACT`, `GROUP` (`production`/`ops`, `dev`, `qa` or
  your own, such as `windows`), `PLATFORM`, `COLLECTOR` (`ssh`,
  `local`, `wra`, `none`), `PROBES`, `PLUGINS`, `ENABLED=no` to pause.
- Shared values go in `etc/hosts/_defaults.conf`; a host file lists only
  what differs.
- Plugin settings: `<category>_<name>_<SETTING>=value`, for example
  `storage_disk_WARN=85`, `storage_disk_SKIP="/mnt/scratch"`,
  `core_cpu_TIMEOUT=60`. The defaults and every setting are in
  `plugins/<category>/<name>/plugin.conf`.
- Linux hosts over SSH need the monitor account's key in the host's
  `authorized_keys`. The collector copies a small bundle to
  `~/drsm_agent` on the host.
- Windows hosts: `utils/wra_hosts.sh` (dry run, then `--apply`) makes a
  host file per agent report. Use `-g` for the group and `-p` for the
  plugins; leave out `windows/resources` for agents older than 3.3.
- Remove a host and its reports: `utils/drsm_remove_host.sh <host>`
  (dry run), then `--apply`.
- From an old `systems.dat` setup: `utils/migrate_systems_dat.sh`.
- Sites that keep Linux hosts in Ansible: set `ANSIBLE_INVENTORY` and
  `ANSIBLE_TIERS` in the config. Then add or move a Linux host in the
  Ansible inventory, not with a host file; a host file only adds
  settings. With Ansible Tower or AWX set `ANSIBLE_TOWER_URL`,
  `ANSIBLE_TOWER_INVENTORY` and `ANSIBLE_TOWER_TOKEN_FILE` instead.
  `utils/drsm_ansible_hosts.sh` and `drsm_run.sh -l` show the result.

## Sites, tiers and links

- `etc/sites/<org>.org` (NAME, CONTACT, LINK) and
  `etc/sites/<org>/<site>.site` (NAME, LOCATION, TZ, ALERT_EMAIL,
  ALERT_EMAIL_<TIER>, STALE_MINUTES, COLLECTOR_ID, LINK, and host
  defaults). A host joins a site with `SITE=<org>/<site>`.
- A single-site install uses `etc/sites/default/default.site` for its
  name and links.
- Links: `LINK="Menu/Submenu/Name|https://url|tier"`. Each `/` makes a
  submenu, http and https only, tier optional. They show in the Site
  links menu after the next run.

## Alerts

- Addresses: `$ALERTdir/alert.email.list` (`EMAILlist`, `TEXTlist`), or
  `ALERT_EMAIL` / `ALERT_EMAIL_<TIER>` in a site file.
- `drsm_run.sh` alerts on ERROR; `-n` turns alerts off for a run (use
  it in cron for groups that should only show on the dashboard).

## Dashboard settings

In `$CONFIGdir/drsm.php` (see `change-the-dashboard.md`): `$SITEtitle`,
`$SITElogo`, `$REFRESHseconds`, `$STALEminutes`, `$NAVextra` (own menu
items), `$EXTreports` (reports from your own scripts), `$AUTH...`
(login). Colors in `$WWWdir/site/custom.css`.

## Why is a host red?

1. Open the host page (Hosts, then the host). Each plugin section shows
   its own lines; the first ERROR line is the cause.
2. "No report posted": the host has a host file but no run has written
   its report yet, or the group's cron line is missing.
3. "Not reporting" / Stale: the report is older than `$STALEminutes`
   (or the site's `STALE_MINUTES`). Check cron and the run log in
   `$LOGdir/drsm_run*.log`.
4. Run it by hand: `drsm_run.sh -n -H <host> -v`.
5. A plugin is UNKNOWN when a command in its `REQUIRES` is missing on
   the host.

## Upgrade

1. Unpack the new release next to the old source.
2. Run `utils/install.sh <new source>` as the DRSM user (or root),
   with `DRSM_CONFIG` set if the install uses it. It keeps
   `_defaults.conf`, host and site files, `plugins/local`, `config/drsm.php`
   (it writes `drsm.php_install_new` beside it) and `$WWWdir/site`.
3. Compare `drsm.php_install_new` with `drsm.php` for new settings.
4. `drsm_run.sh -l`, then one run with `-n`.

File: docs/ai/write-a-plugin.md
----------------------------------------------------------------

# Write a DRSM plugin

A check is a folder `plugins/<category>/<name>/` with `plugin.conf`
and `check.sh` (runs on the host) or `probe.sh` (runs on the monitor
host against the host). Site-only plugins go in `plugins/local/`.
The full reference is `PLUGINS.md`, section "Writing a plugin".

## Steps

1. `utils/new_plugin.sh local/<name>` (or `local/<name> probe`) makes
   the folder from a template.
2. Fill in `plugin.conf`: `NAME`, `CATEGORY`, `DESCRIPTION`,
   `PLATFORMS` (`linux`, `windows`, `any`), `MODE` (`remote` or
   `probe`), `TIMEOUT`, `REQUIRES` (commands that must exist),
   `NEEDS_SUDO`, then one `KEY=default` line per setting.
3. Write the script:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
source "${DRSM_LIB:-$(dirname "$0")/../../../lib}/drsm_plugin.sh"

WARN=$(drsm_setting WARN 100)
CRIT=$(drsm_setting CRIT 500)

count=$(find /var/spool/myapp -type f | wc -l)
if [ "${count}" -ge "${CRIT}" ]; then
    drsm_crit "${HOST} myapp queue has ${count} files"
elif [ "${count}" -ge "${WARN}" ]; then
    drsm_warn "${HOST} myapp queue has ${count} files"
else
    drsm_ok "${HOST} myapp queue checks good at ${count} files"
fi
drsm_metric myapp_queue_files "${count}"
drsm_exit
```

4. Run it by hand: `DRSM_WARN=50 bash plugins/local/<name>/check.sh`
   (probes: `DRSM_TARGET=<host> bash .../probe.sh`).
5. Add it to `PLUGINS` (or `PROBES`) in a host file or
   `_defaults.conf`, then `drsm_run.sh -n -H <host> -v`.

## Helpers (lib/drsm_plugin.sh)

`drsm_ok`/`drsm_info` (INFO), `drsm_warn` (WARNING), `drsm_crit`
(ERROR, alerts), `drsm_unknown`, `drsm_metric name value [labels]`
(trends), `drsm_detail name value` (host page Details), `drsm_setting
NAME default`, `drsm_target`, `drsm_gt a b` (float compare),
`drsm_exit`. Settings arrive as `DRSM_<KEY>`; hosts override them with
`<category>_<name>_<KEY>`.

## Rules

- BASH only, and only commands found on a minimal RHEL install unless
  listed in `REQUIRES`.
- Messages start with the host name and say what is wrong and the value.
- Never prompt, never write outside `/tmp` on the host, finish well
  inside `TIMEOUT`.
- A plugin for the DRSM release also needs a test in
  `tests/drsm_run_test.sh`, a row in the PLUGINS.md table and
  docs/plugins.html, and a CHANGELOG entry.

----------------------------------------------------------------
File: docs/ai/change-the-dashboard.md
----------------------------------------------------------------

# Change the DRSM dashboard

The dashboard is plain PHP pages in `www/php/` (installed to
`$WWWdir/php/`), one stylesheet `www/css/drsm.css` and one script
`www/js/drsm.js`. Pages read the report files in `$REPORTdir`; they
never run checks or write reports.

## Settings first

Most site changes need no code. In `$CONFIGdir/drsm.php`:

```php
$SITEtitle = 'Example System Monitor';   // top bar name
$SITElogo = '/images/logo.svg';          // logo before the name
$REFRESHseconds = 300;                   // auto refresh, 0 off
$STALEminutes = 120;                     // report age that counts as not reporting
$NAVextra = array(                       // own top bar items
  array("label" => "Classic", "url" => "/classic/", "icon" => "layout"),
  array("label" => "Tools", "url" => "/tools/", "icon" => "link",
        "sub" => array(array("Time converter", "/tools/utc.php"))));
$EXTreports = '/var/www/html/dashboard/config/ext_reports.conf';
$EXTtitle = 'Site reports';
```

Icons: grid, heat, list, trend, net, file, windows, layout, link,
external, building, cloud, archive, lock, alert, check.

### Reports from your own scripts ($EXTreports)

```
# Title | report file | link | max age minutes | status file
[backups] Backups and patching
PROD backups | /var/www/html/sysadmin/backup/prod_summary.txt | | 1500
SSL certificates | /path/all_certs.txt | | 1500 | /path/cert_errors.txt
Scan results | /path/scan.txt | | | -
Storage console | - | https://storage.example.com/
```

ERROR or FAILED in the status file (default: the report file) is an
error, WARNING a warning, a missing file an error, older than the max
age Stale (`ETIME:` line, else the file time). An empty link shows the
file in the dashboard; `-` as the file is a plain link; `-` as the
status file shows the report with no state.

### Colors and header

`$WWWdir/site/custom.css` loads after `drsm.css`; override the CSS
variables (`--accent`, `--accent-2`, ...) for light and dark themes.
A full custom header is `$WWWdir/site/page_header.php`; it must print
`drsm_head_assets()` and leave `<main>` open.

## Code changes

- Page skeleton, as in `www/php/extreports.php`:

```php
require_once("../config/drsm.php");
require_once("{$WWWdir}/php/query_post_validation.php");
require_once("{$WWWdir}/php/drsm_lib.php");
drsm_page_start("Title", "menu-key", $state);
// ... HTML, every value through h() ...
drsm_page_end();
```

- Helpers in `drsm_lib.php`: `h()`, `drsm_url($page, $args)`,
  `drsm_load_hosts()`, `drsm_badge($state)`, `drsm_time_html($t)`,
  `drsm_icon($name)`, `drsm_read_lines($file)`, `drsm_worst($a, $b)`,
  states OK, WARNING, ERROR, UNKNOWN, STALE. Sites and links are in
  `drsm_sites.php`, other script reports in `drsm_ext.php`, login in
  `drsm_auth.php`, trends in `trends_lib.php`.
- The top bar is `default_header.php` (`$drsm_nav`, `$drsm_sub`).
- PHP 7.2 compatible code only, no PHP warnings or notices.
- A request may pick an ID, never a file path.
- Add a new PHP file to the `files=` list in `utils/install.sh`.
- Add checks for the change to `tests/www_test.sh` (`render`, `expect`,
  `reject`) and run all of `tests/*.sh`.
- Document it in `docs/dashboard.html` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Screenshots for the docs: headless Chrome against `php -S` on a copy
  made by `utils/make_web_demo.sh -s`.
